label: miso 51 gasdaily hydro ablation
definition: (ABLATION TWIN of 2026-07-09-miso-51-gasdaily-hydro) Rule-20 zero-forcing reference solve of the miso-51 recipe (gas_daily_shape[MISO] + hydro 2024-backfill/EIA-930 repin on the re-derived measured coal sigmoid): every merchant commitment floor/bridge OFF, keeping only nuclear must-run, CHP steam-following and coal take-or-pay.
